title: Life Dashboard Companion webhook payload
description: Every JSON body the app POSTs to a webhook: Health Connect payloads (source health_connect), Screen Time payloads (source screen_time), test pings (test: true) and the heartbeats of Receive. A record array is present only when it holds at least one record, so a payload never carries an empty one. Every record also carries source (the package that wrote it) and uuid (Health Connect's record id). The iOS app sends the same shape with source healthkit_ios. Field-by-field documentation is in webhook.md next to this file.

device.description: Screen Time payloads only: the phone's manufacturer and model, such as "Google Pixel 8"

sequence.description: Increases with every payload this install sends, health_connect and screen_time alike (one counter, so per source it can skip). A receiver that keeps the highest sequence it has applied per source can ignore an older health_connect payload that arrives late after a retry. For screen_time compare per date instead: each payload re-sends a sliding week, so a late one can still hold the oldest date that no newer payload covers; keep the sequence that last wrote each date and apply a day only from a payload with a higher one. Optional: absent on test pings and Receive heartbeats, on screen_time payloads from 1.20.0 and older, and healthkit_ios may omit it, so treat a missing field as unknown rather than zero.

deleted_records.description: Records Health Connect deleted since the previous sync. Absent when there are none. A receiver should drop the record with this uuid from the named collection.

type.description: The payload key the record arrived under, e.g. nutrition

uuid.description: The uuid the record was delivered with

deletions_unavailable.description: Payload keys of the types whose deletions this sync cannot vouch for: the change feed of the type expired (Health Connect forgets it after 30 days without a read), held more changes than one sync reads, could not be read, or did not answer within the deletion step's time limit (5 s per type, 20 s in total). Deletions of these types may be missing; reconcile them against a completed backfill window. Absent when every type could vouch for its deletions.

records_outside_window.description: Per payload key, records that a source wrote or edited since the previous sync with a timestamp before the range this sync read (read_from in _diagnostics), so they are not in the payload: for instance a watch that uploads after more than a week away from the phone. A backfill of from to until sends them. Absent when there are none.

count.description: How many such changes Health Connect reported

from.description: Timestamp of the oldest of them

until.description: Where the range the sync read started (read_from in _diagnostics), not the time of the newest such record

test.description: Present, and true, only on a test ping: a POST that proves the address and the secret work and carries no records, only timestamp, app_version, source and message besides. Sent by Test ping on the tabs, by the setup wizard and right after a QR pairing.

message.description: Human readable text of a test ping; absent on every other payload

backfill.description: True on payloads from a one-time history export; absent on ordinary syncs

window_start.description: Backfill only: start of the window this payload belongs to. Windows are 72 hours long (the last one can be shorter), the first starting 30, 90 or 365 days before the moment the backfill started, so their bounds fall at that time of day, not at midnight

window_end.description: Backfill only: end of the window this payload belongs to; the last window ends at the moment the backfill started

window_complete.description: Backfill only: true on the last payload of a window, meaning every record the phone holds for that window has now been sent. A receiver may treat uuids it holds in that range that were not in the window as deleted. False means the window is not complete yet: either more payloads of it follow, or the backfill stopped at this window (a type could not be read, or the window needed more than 400 payloads) and sends it again from the start when it runs again. Never treat missing uuids as deleted on false.

_diagnostics.description: Per payload key, what Health Connect returned for each type this payload read. Present on Health Connect payloads that carry records and on the payload of an empty backfill window; absent on Screen Time payloads, test pings, heartbeats and payloads that carry only deletions. A payload after the first of one sync has entries only for the types still draining a backlog.

raw_record_count.description: Records Health Connect returned for the read range, before the watermark filter; samples for heart rate and skin temperature

raw_latest_modified_time.description: Newest modification time among those records

min_time.description: Oldest timestamp among the delivered records

max_time.description: Newest timestamp among the delivered records

last_sync.description: The watermark this read filtered against

error.description: Why the type was not read, or was read only in part; null otherwise

own_records_skipped.description: Records this app wrote itself through Receive that were left out of the payload

lookback_gap_from.description: Null unless the phone did not sync for so long that the range could not reach back far enough: records timestamped from here up to read_from that were written or edited in that time were not read, and a backfill of that range sends them

writeback.description: Health Connect payloads to the Life Dashboard integration only, when Receive is on: what the phone can write, and the outcome of what the integration sent last time. Absent on every other payload. The integration's response is described in webhook.md under Inbound.

types.description: The types switched on and permitted; the integration sends readings of these only

history.description: True when the phone accepts measurements older than 30 days

ack.description: Ids of readings written since the previous request

failed.description: Readings not written, each with a code; never a value

items.description: A raw record, or an aggregate when this series has a resolution set

source.description: Package name of the app that wrote the record to Health Connect

uuid.description: Stable record id for server-side deduplication

bucket_start.description: Start of the window, aligned to the clock in UTC

sample_count.description: Records that went into this window, so a receiver can tell a sparse bucket from a full one

complete.description: Present when the bucket holds every record the window had when it was built: replace a stored window with it. Absent: combine it with the stored window. Only accumulated series carry it.

session_end_time.description: End of the session; its start is session_end_time minus duration_seconds

stage.description: On Android one of unknown, awake, sleeping, out_of_bed, light, deep, rem, awake_in_bed

app_filter.description: Screen Time payloads only, and only with an app filter on: the apps array of each day is a selection, and filtered_screen_time_minutes its sum

date.description: The day as the app counts it: from the Screen Time day boundary (04:00 local time by default) to the same hour the next day, or midnight to midnight with the boundary switched off

total_screen_time_minutes.description: Every app's foreground minutes, including apps an app filter leaves out

filtered_screen_time_minutes.description: The minutes of the apps in this day's apps array; only when an app filter is on (app_filter)

apps.description: Apps with more than one minute of foreground time that day; with an app filter on, only the apps the filter lets through

name.description: The app's label on the phone

screen_time.description: Screen Time payloads only: the last 7 days, one entry per day. Store per date and apply a day only from a payload with a higher sequence than the one that last wrote it.

daily_totals.description: Per local day, totals from Health Connect's aggregate API, which deduplicates overlapping sources (phone plus watch). Ordinary syncs carry today and the two days before, today's entry being a running total; a backfill carries every day its window touches. Absent when switched off in the app.

date.description: The phone's local day, midnight to midnight

_resolutions.description: Window used per bucketed series; absent series are raw records

recordMetadata.description: Health Connect's metadata of the record, when Record metadata is on in the app (off by default). Fields Health Connect did not have are absent. Nutrition records and buckets carry none.

last_modified.description: When the record was last written; a source that revises a record moves it

client_record_id.description: The writing app's own id for the record

client_record_version.description: The writing app's version of the record; only with client_record_id

zone_offset.description: UTC offset of a record at one moment, such as +02:00, or Z for UTC

start_zone_offset.description: UTC offset at the start of a record over a period, such as +02:00, or Z for UTC. Heart rate and skin temperature samples carry the offsets of their record.

end_zone_offset.description: UTC offset at its end, in the same form
